title: Hyperspectral imaging combined with data fusion for non-destructive prediction of soluble solids content and water-soluble sugars in strawberries during storage after static-pressure bruising

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Hyperspectral imaging combined with data fusion for non-destructive prediction of soluble solids content and water-soluble sugars in strawberries during storage after static-pressure bruising》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】This study aimed to investigate the feasibility of predicting SSC as well as fructose and glucose contents in strawberries subjected to Static-Pressure Bruising followed by different storage durations using two hyperspectral imaging techniques (Vis-NIR and NIR) combined with low-level and mid-level data fusion strategies (LLF and MLF).
